# Sample Authentication Architecture Project

Demonstration repository showing coordinated AST symbol tracing in CodeAtlas.

## Architecture Overview

- **Frontend Client:** `src/components/LoginForm.tsx`
- **Service Layer:** `src/services/auth.ts`
- **Validation Utilities:** `src/utils/validation.ts`
- **Test Suite:** `tests/auth.test.ts`

## Call Path

```text
LoginForm.tsx
      ↓ calls
src/services/auth.ts (loginUser)
      ↓ executes
src/utils/validation.ts (validateEmail)
      ↓ dispatches HTTP
POST /api/v1/auth/session
      ↓ verified by
tests/auth.test.ts
```

reviewSessions.summary: Analyzed 2 changed file(s) across PR #101. Identified 1 critical security issue(s) and 1 logic/contract warning(s) that require attention before merge.

findings.title: Missing input validation & token revocation check in rotateRefreshToken
findings.description: The new `rotateRefreshToken(oldToken)` function forwards `oldToken` directly to `/api/v1/auth/refresh` without checking whether `oldToken` is null, empty, or previously invalidated in session storage.
findings.whyItMatters: Sending unvalidated tokens can lead to unhandled server 500 errors or replay attacks if revoked tokens are not rejected prior to dispatch.
findings.suggestedRemediation: Add early validation guard: `if (!oldToken || typeof oldToken !== 'string') throw new Error('Valid refresh token required');` before network dispatch.

findings.title: Off-by-one boundary check rejects valid 8-character passwords
findings.description: The expression `password.length > 8` changes the contract from `>= 8` to strictly greater than 8, which will immediately break unit test assertions in `tests/auth.test.ts`.
findings.whyItMatters: Violates existing password specification that accepts 8-character passwords, breaking unit test `validatePassword enforces 8-character minimum`.

sharedArtifacts.title: Auth Architecture Snapshot
sharedArtifacts.description: Verified symbol call graph and token validation path across LoginForm and auth services.
sharedArtifacts.content:
### Authentication Architecture Blueprint

Traced `LoginForm` -> `handleSubmit` -> `loginUser` -> `UserService`.

- **Token Scheme**: JWT RS256 with 15-minute access token lifespan.
- **Password Security**: BCrypt with salted rounds.
- **Call Hierarchy**: Client Form triggers validation in `validation.ts` before delegating to `auth.ts`.

- **Target Change**: Enforcing `process.env.JWT_SECRET` presence with zero fallback string.
- **Direct Callers**: 2 modules (`auth.ts`, `session.ts`)
- **API Endpoints**: `POST /api/auth/login`
- **Test Coverage**: `tests/auth.test.ts` covers failure scenario.
